MAE 대비 ≤1%(d_qforge_migration_routing 정합). 동기(demiurge RAREEARTH-FREE 캠페인): RE-free 자석 P1 물리천장 lever(b)(interstitial-N D019·정방왜곡 Fe-Co·HEA 3d) DFT 정밀검증을 summer 무료 GPU davidson서 자체수행(유료 vast 회피). 기존 davidson/sternheimer/dfpt_response/scf_pw/elph_scf selftest(qforge-g5-regate-r2 5/5 PASS) 위에 spinor 확장. provenance: demiurge ING work#28 · ARCHITECTURE.json RAREEARTH-FREE L20(flat-band escape CLOSED-NEGATIVE·Co3Mo 0.2 MJ/m3).
